resources.string: The &TERMUX_APP_NAME; app $PREFIX directory is not accessible by the %1$s app. This may be because you have not installed or setup &TERMUX_APP_NAME; app or &TERMUX_APP_NAME; app and %1$s app both have different APK signatures because you have managed to install both apps from different sources. It may also be because &TERMUX_APP_NAME; $PREFIX directory \"&TERMUX_PREFIX_DIR_PATH;\" does not exist or does not have read, write and execute permissions."
